symptom: create workflow … display 'X' over --mcp stores the document name as the workflow title and workflowName (Studio Pro 11.14 and 11.15).
cause: The context-shaped Workflows$Workflow constructor ignores the title (11.14 'caption', 11.15 'title') and workflowName it is given; 11.15 also renamed caption->title, which its permissive schema would have dropped silently anyway.
fix: workflowConstructorTakesContext's probe records the title key (workflowCtorTitle); workflowCreateLeafOps sets /title and /workflowName/text after the create (set ops both releases accept).
insight: Read back what a constructor stored instead of trusting SUCCESS: both releases accepted the key and applied nothing.
